Status definitions
  • Fulfilled: Scripture later records the predicted event.
  • Ongoing: The promised or judged condition continues.
  • Partial / ongoing: Some elements occurred, while others continue or remain future.
  • Conditional: Fulfillment depended upon a stated response.
  • Disputed: Significant interpretations disagree.
  • Restatement: An earlier promise is repeated rather than newly introduced.
